items.title: Randy Brecker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 12, 2022
items.q: He was a lawyer by trade and worked generally for a friend of his whose name was Max Raab

ctx.x: May I ask how long your father lived and did he — was he able to see the success that you had as a musician?
Yeah he was. He was a lawyer by trade and worked generally for a friend of his whose name was Max Raab who was a blouse maker and had a very successful business so he

ended up being his legal counsel and Max Raab also sponsored concerts. He was a real jazz fan. So dad — it’s hard to describe — he would consciously try to discourage both me and Mike from the music business because it was so unstable and he was afraid it would be hard to make a living. But once we caught on so to speak — man he was our biggest fan. You know he’d go up to everybody and say, “You heard of the Brecker brothers? I’m the Brecker father.” And, you know, it was embarrassing.
